description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget representing a chat page screen, which includes an app bar, a message display area with a sample assistant message, an image, an info banner, and a message composer with input and action buttons. It is purely UI-focused without networking or state management.

classes.name: ChatPageScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that builds the main chat page, including app bar, message area, and bottom composer.

classes.name: _ChatAppBar
classes.description: A custom AppBar widget with back button and title.

classes.name: _MessagesArea
classes.description: Displays the assistant message card with banner, image, message text, and action icons.

classes.name: _ActionIcon
classes.description: Reusable widget for action icons with semantics for accessibility.

classes.name: _ComposerBar
classes.description: Bottom input bar with text field and send/mic buttons.

classes.name: _ComposerTextField
classes.description: Stateful widget managing the message input text field.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the entire chat page scaffold with app bar and body.
